output.reason: [ev-f0029965e392] says Istio 1.24's stricter gRPC validation affects the third-party CA istio-csr. A failed handshake with the CA is a broken integration, so workload-failure with high severity fits the evidence. The suggested fix (the workaround install settings, or an istio-csr version with the upstream fix) matches the text.
